newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka delays awarding rice tender till Friday.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka delays awarding rice tender till Friday.

text.p: Sri Lanka will decide on awarding a 50,000 tonne rice tender on Friday, the state buying arm Cooperative Wholesale Establishment (CWE) said on Friday.
CWE officials earlier said the tender board would decide on the tender early this week. They gave no reason for the delay.
"The tender board will meet on Friday afternoon to consider offers," a CWE official said.
A total of 41 exporters responded to the Sri Lankan government tender for 50,000 tonnes of rice for October/November delivery.
